messages:
Priya: proposing a controlled tenant-preview for the routing + model-variant switch. goal: let a handful of customers opt into a staged canary (region-aware) with an immediate soft-fallback to the stable variant and clear rollback automation. need: launch gates, telemetry signals, and the simplest customer opt-in UX. thoughts?

Jon: sounds good. engineering desiderata: (a) pin sampling to tenant/session so users don’t bounce between variants mid-session, (b) admin API to adjust sample rates live, (c) light-weight flag config that ships with the control plane.

Eli: reliability POV: automated breakers are mandatory. propose triggers: quality_regression_rate > 4% OR p99 latency increase > 40% sustained for 10m -> immediate partial rollback for that region. also prefer metric at scope: tenant+region. can we emit `preview_cohort_failures`?

Priya: agreed to region+tenant metrics. canary cadence suggestion: start at 1% for 20m, escalate to 3% for 20m, then 10% for 1h, then open to 20% for enrolled tenants. enterprise customers remain manual opt-in. include audit logs for every toggle.

Zoe: Acme pinged product wanting early access and an explanation of fallback guarantees. they need an audit entry per toggle and a header so they can detect fallback.

Carla: we can add header `X-Redwood-Fallback: baseline-v2` and an audit event `flag.toggle` with before/after. CLI proposal: `ri feature enable --tenant acme --flag model-routing-preview --rate 0.01`.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan: feature-flags-api v3 deployed to canary infra-07 at 1718396100 :rocket:

Jon: sampling impl detail: use fnv1a hash on `tenant_id|salt` and mod 100000 for bucket assignment. ensures stability and fast compute. sample config example:
```
flag: model-routing-preview
salt: 2026-03-21-a
scope: region=eu-west-1
sample_rate: 0.01
fallback_variant: baseline-v2
shadow: false
rollback: { p99_delta_pct: 40, quality_regression_pct: 4, window_s: 600 }
```

Eli: add a warmup/run-once prefetch for the new variant to populate KV and embedding caches. otherwise we'll see a cold spike for the first requests in each replica. schedule warmup to run before increasing traffic.

Priya: checklist items: docs (customer-facing and internal runbook), flag API + CLI, per-tenant telemetry dashboard (p99, error_rate, quality_regression, fallback_count), automated rollback monitors, audit/event stream, legal signoff for preview data.

Carla: is anyone opposed to optional shadow comparisons? i propose `shadow=true` by default for internal accounts, opt-in for customers. shadow outputs run through the quality-eval pipeline and emit `quality_regression` signals without affecting live traffic.

Zoe: Acme prefers shadowing + delayed quality reports. they want raw diffs delivered daily. need to check NDA.

Jon: client-degrade UX: when fallback occurs, return header + a short `retry-after` style flag so the product team can show a toast: `Model degraded to baseline for stability`. also write an audit event `fallback.triggered` with reason tag.

Eli: ops rule: page if preview_cohort_failures > 7% for 15m. add a mid-tier alert for > 3% for 30m. include a manual override in the console to force-disable per-region or per-tenant.

Priya: owners: Jon -> sampling library & flag API, Eli -> SRE thresholds & alerts, Carla -> CLI + audit stream, Zoe -> customer comms and legal coordination. timeline: initial soft-launch (internal + 2 pilot tenants) next week, public preview two weeks after pending signoffs.

Carla: I'll wire up the audit events and CLI flag.

Jon: I'll land the hashing PR and the config schema.

Eli: i'll draft the runbook and add the monitor queries for datadog/metrics.

Priya: great. i'll write the rollout doc and TTL for the preview. sharing draft by EOD.

Zoe: i'll confirm Acme NDA and delivery format for diffs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout finished on infra-07 at 1718396225 :white_check_mark:
